_comment: M01 owns real login, sessions, TOTP and recovery. It binds a FAKE REGISTRY ONLY -- it provides the real Access, so it binds no fake Access. There is no synthetic persona in any profile, because a persona would bypass the login flow under test.
_no_sms: No SMS or email provider is started or reachable. The notifications port is not even a declared consumer, so device-loss recovery is proved to work with no SMS service.

_scenario_notes.baseline: Owner O1, teacher T1 (staff, 2FA required), guardian G1 (optional 2FA), principal P1 (can approve resets), and an owner at School B that exists only to prove two-school isolation. Preloads an already-expired challenge, an already-used recovery code and a pending lost-device case, so those paths are testable without waiting five minutes.
_scenario_notes.empty: No rows, for empty-state UI and migration-on-empty checks.
